Anchal Shukla TGT 17 .9.25 Understanding Dyslexia HRDC, DPSS Prof. Renu Malviya Define and recognize Dyslexia as a type of Specific Learning Disability (SLD) under the broader umbrella of learning difficulties. 2. Identify the characteristics and challenges faced by learners with dyslexia, including difficulties in reading, writing, spelling, and comprehension. 3. Differentiate Dyslexia from other SLDs (e.g., dysgraphia, dyspraxia, dyscalculia, etc.). 4. Understand how SLDs interfere with learning by affecting acquisition of academic skills, executive functioning, and social interaction. 5. Appreciate the strengths and unique abilities of individuals with dyslexia (e.g., creativity, multi-dimensional thinking). 6. Explore Response to Intervention (RTI) as a framework for early identification, timely support, and collaborative strategies for helping students with dyslexia.
